You simply play the role of a prospective buyer who wants the firm to manage the property once it is purchased.

title: Irrevocable Real Estate Sub Trust Draft
desc:

Must comply with Laws and regulations if miami dade county and state of floruda

I will supply my current estate documents and the specific guidelines that the new sub-trust must follow (distribution rules, successor trustee provisions, and any required references to the master trust). Your job is to translate those directions into a fully compliant legal document that satisfies state law, records cleanly with the county recorder, and protects the asset long-term.

Deliverables
• Final irrevocable sub-trust agreement in editable Word and PDF  
• Any ancillary documents needed for conveyance (e.g., warranty or quit-claim deed, assignment of beneficial interest)  
• A brief implementation memo summarizing filing/recording steps and future trustee actions  

Acceptance Criteria
• Language reflects all provided guidelines without contradiction  
• Clearly states irrevocability and segregation of liability from the master trust  
• Ready for signature and recording with no further drafting required  

If you have solid trust-law experience—especially with real-estate-holding sub-trusts—let’s collaborate so I can finalize this component of my estate plan swiftly and accurately.
